def.state: board 20EMA trend state (eval_lib outcomes, agg any, hysteresis 2/0.5)

direction.price: sign(last close − first open) over the segment

closeDirection.state: sign(cu − cd) over the close window
closeDirection.fresh: sign(up − dn) over seq with the leading run equal to s1 dropped

def.outcome: follow = same sign; reverse = opposite; none = close direction 0

refs.day: cash session up to the close window
refs.day90: cash session up to the 90-minute window (15-minute window only)
refs.pre: the 75 minutes before the final window (15-minute window only)
refs.full: from 08:00 UK to the close window (US rows only)
